infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the TerraGroup storage room on Factory.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup storage room keycard (Polikhim) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An access keycard for the TerraGroup storage room, located inside Chemical Plant No. 16.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Dragnet
- This is a required location for the story chapter The Unheard

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the TerraGroup storage room on Factory. Next to the "Camera Bunker Door" Scav extraction in the underground.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- 2x TerraGroup safe
- 1x Jacket
- 1x Toolbox
- 1x Medbag
- 1x Weapon locker
- Possible LEDX Skin Transilluminator on the top corner of the left shelf
- Possible Physical Bitcoin spawn
